'''2008 Worlds Day 2 James Barnes DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Barnes]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[James Barnes]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
